result.rationale: The migration inserts migrated values via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...)`), bypassing the model's `before_validation` callback that strips `http(s)://` and paths. Meanwhile `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches with `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, so any imported host stored as 'http://eviltrout.com' (a form the old setting explicitly allowed per removed specs like 'https://example.com/1234') will never match after upgrade. Verifiable correctness/data-loss defect in the diff.
